curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42110-1-1.pdf (one book of 496 pages, steps 1-860; the functions are drawn on pages 490-491: the gearbox and its three levers on 490, everything else on 491)

functions.does: The gear knob on the roof (hand of God) steers the front wheels: a vertical shaft down the left of the cab turns a long shaft forward through bevel gears, and a train of gears at the front turns the 12 tooth pinion on the steering rack, which pushes the steering links to swing both front hubs.
functions.source: book page 491 (top left: the knob on the roof turned, the front wheel swinging); the gear train is inferred from the model

functions.does: The steering wheel turns with the steering, through universal joints from the steering gear train.
functions.source: book page 491 (top left: the steering wheel turns with the knob on the roof)

functions.does: All four wheels are driven: pushing the car along turns the wheels, which through the front and rear differentials, a centre differential, the gearbox and the range and D-N-R selectors turn the engine's crankshaft, so the six pistons of the straight-six engine pump up and down.
functions.source: book page 490 (the drivetrain drawn inside the car), page 491 (top: the pistons moving); the gear train is inferred from the model
functions.note: Only in a gear with D or R selected; in N the engine stands still. p2606 and p2608 are the left wheels, p2613 and p2611 the right.

functions.does: Open differentials in the front and rear axles and a centre differential between them let every wheel turn at its own speed: with the engine held, turning one front wheel turns the other the opposite way.
functions.source: book page 490 (three differentials drawn); inferred: the test, from the model

functions.does: The four-speed sequential gearbox at the back: tipping the + / - lever between the front seats turns a rod running back to a 4 tooth knob gear, which turns the changeover rotary catch one step, moving the driving rings to the next gear up or down.
functions.source: book page 490 (+ / - picture and the 4-speed sequential gearbox labelled in the drawing); the linkage is inferred from the model
functions.note: Unsure which part is the lever's handle; p385 is the rod it turns. The rod lies along the car, so the lever tips sideways.

functions.does: The D-N-R lever in the console slides a driving ring in the gearbox in front of the console, choosing forward, neutral or reverse.
functions.source: book page 490 (D N R picture); inferred: which lever and driving ring
functions.note: Unsure which of the two console levers is D-N-R: by the + / - picture on page 490, D-N-R is on the left (p377, over the driving ring p330) and HI-LO on the right (p368, over p331), but it could be the other way round.

functions.does: The HI-LO lever beside it slides the other driving ring in the same gearbox, choosing the high or low range.
functions.source: book page 490 (LO HI picture); inferred: which lever and driving ring

functions.does: The winch in the front bumper: the hook pulls the string out, and turning the 12 tooth knob under the bonnet, front right, winds it back in through a vertical shaft, bevel gears and a shaft across the bumper to the reel.
Four independent suspension arms with shock absorbers let each wheel move up and down on its own; the front wheels steer on theirs.
functions.source: book page 491 (middle: arrows at each wheel); front suspension steps 1-40, rear after

functions.does: The two front doors open on their hinges.
The bonnet lifts, hinged at its back edge, showing the engine.
functions.source: book page 491 (bottom right; bottom middle shows it open)

functions.does: Turning the spare wheel on the tailgate works the tailgate's latch, and the tailgate then swings open sideways.
functions.note: Then the tailgate (p1478 64782) swings open on its hinge.

functions.does: The lid of the box on the roof rack lifts open.
The lid of the case on the right side of the roof swings open.
The roof, with its rack, lifts off.
functions.source: book page 491 (right: arrow lifting it off)
functions.skip: taken off by hand, not a mechanism
